title: Victron Metric0 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=victron:metric0
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day victron metric0 events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on victron metric0 events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back what time of day your victron metric0 feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
